# betterado_serviceendpoint_incomingwebhook (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)
- `service_endpoint_name` (String)
- `webhook_name` (String) The name of the WebHook.

### Optional
